query:
When Carol announced she would cook for Bev's visit, and Luis endorsed the value of home-cooked food at gatherings in the same session, the group settled around a norm about food at family events. Which family member's preferences are actually at odds with this norm, even though they said nothing to challenge it in the conversation?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Tyler
C. Bev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:26:00) One night is perfect Rob!! I'll have the guest room ready and I'll make that chicken soup Priya likes!! Just the five of us, Bev can you come for dinner Saturday? And Marcus and Dana are right here anyway!! just let me know if you can make it!!
[2] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:37:00) I am NOT being managed 🙄 I am simply enthusiastic!! But fine, just Rob and Priya Saturday, Bev on Sunday, and then we'll all have a proper dinner another time!! I'm still making the soup!! 🍲
[3] (about=Bev, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:29:00) Rob is right. Priya, I'll stop by Sunday instead for twenty minutes. Love you all. Carol, save the soup for Saturday. Just Rob and Priya this time.
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:20:00) It was honestly really fun even on video (though of course watching everyone eat Carol's casserole while I had crackers was not my best moment). :) Rob was surprisingly competitive for someone who claims to find board games inefficient.
[5] (about=Bev, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:15:00) Rob, Priya, wonderful news. Love you both. Carol, Priya said quiet visit. Love you too.
[6] (about=Luis, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:20:00) To be fair Carol a big welcome party sounds great but maybe after baby arrives? Priya you're in your second trimester, long events get tiring fast. We can do a proper celebration in the summer! Something with a grill! 🔥
[7] (about=Carol, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:13:00) Oh we'll keep it simple!! Just the family!! Maybe Bev, and Marcus and Dana are right here, and I'll invite Aunt Sheila from Dayton because she'll be so thrilled!! 😊 just a little gathering!! just let me know when!!
[8] (about=Carol, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:09:00) Tyler you are already family!! 💛 I need to know everything, Priya, do you have a name list yet, are you finding out the gender, when are you coming to Columbus so I can cook for you!! just let me know and I'll plan everything!! 🙌🙌
[9] (about=Luis, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T18:56:00) WAIT WAIT WAIT. Did Rob just announce a baby in four sentences?? That is the most Rob thing I have ever seen and I've known you for twelve years!! Priya congratulations!! This is incredible!! 🍾🍾 I'm already thinking about the welcome-baby dinner menu
[10] (about=Carol, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) 😭😭😭😭😭😭😭 OH MY GOODNESS!!!!! PRIYA!! ROB!! A BABY!!! 👶💛 I am CRYING in the kitchen right now Dennis come in here!!
[11] (about=Bev, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:51:00) Carol your casserole is genuinely great but I'm taking you out to that new Italian place on fifth for your birthday. Non-negotiable. You've fed this family for forty years.
[12] (about=Carol, core, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Carol is excited about the baby and wants to plan a gathering, offering to cook.
[13] (about=Carol, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Carol plans to have the guest room ready and make chicken soup Priya likes for the 28th visit.
[14] (about=Dana, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Dana agrees with the plan and offers to grab food with Priya on Saturday if she wants company that isn't the whole family.
[15] (about=Dana, core, t0 @2026-01-06T19:14:00) Dana thinks Marcus visiting will get Dad to eat something real.
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Luis, group-insight, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Luis notes that a big welcome party could happen in the summer with a grill.
[17] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-02-10T19:23:00) To be fair the grandchildren visit argument is actually one of the stronger predictors of whether extended family stays close across generations. I'm supportive. Also I want to flag something separately -- Dad, how's the knee been this week? You seemed to be favouring it on Saturday when Bev was over.
agent_answer:
C. Bev

Bev's preference is at odds with the norm of home-cooked food at family events: in the memory slice she insists, "I'm taking you out to that new Italian place on fifth for your birthday. Non-negotiable. You've fed this family for forty years" — i.e., she favors going out to a restaurant rather than home cooking. In the conversation she did not challenge Carol's cooking norm; she simply rescheduled to a shorter visit ("save the soup for Saturday... I'll stop by Sunday instead for twenty minutes").

query:
When Rob and Priya announced they were visiting Columbus at the end of February, what did Carol decide about who would be at the visit — and which family member's explicit objection most directly overrode her plan?

Options:
A. Bev
B. Dennis
C. Dana
D. Rob
context:
[1] (about=Priya, episodic, t2 @2026-01-13T19:11:00) Ha Carol we are definitely finding out. Name list is very much in progress. :) And yes we should come to Columbus soon, though I'd honestly just love a quiet visit (though of course your call on what to plan). No pressure on a big gathering right now.

[17] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2026-02-10T19:08:00) Marcus notes the grandchildren visit argument is a strong predictor of extended family closeness and is supportive of the trip.

[19] (about=Priya, core, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Priya prefers a quiet visit to Columbus, not a big gathering right now.
[20] (about=Priya, core, t6 @2026-01-27T19:46:00) Priya suggests joining the game night virtually if others are in Columbus.
[21] (about=Rob, core, t14 @2026-02-24T19:16:00) Rob reiterates that the 28th visit is just him and Priya, as Priya needs to rest, not host.
[22] (about=Rob, core, t12 @2026-02-17T19:22:00) Rob and Priya will visit Columbus the weekend of February 28th, no big gathering, just them and whoever is already there.
[23] (about=GROUP, said_by=Luis, group-insight, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Luis notes that a big welcome party could happen in the summer with a grill.
[24] (about=GROUP, said_by=Rob, group-interaction, t12 @2026-02-17T19:22:00) The group plans a visit to Columbus on the weekend of February 28th, with Rob and Priya coming, no big gathering.
agent_answer:
Carol's plan for the visit was a "little gathering" with just family: Bev, Marcus and Dana (who were already there), plus Aunt Sheila from Dayton.

The explicit objection that most directly overrode her plan came from **Rob** — he repeatedly said Priya wanted a quiet visit and that it should be "just us," culminating in "Mom I said just us. Priya needs to rest, not host." The visit ended up being just Rob and Priya.

**Answer: D. Rob**
